name: Windows Audit Directory Service Access (Failure)
description:
Ensures the advanced audit policy subcategory 'Directory Service Access' records failure events (Success and Failure also passes). Relevant on domain controllers. Parsed from the English-language auditpol output. Enable 'Audit: Force audit policy subcategory settings to override audit policy category settings' so subcategory policy takes effect.
Required Windows permission: the LEA agent account must be allowed to run auditpol /get /category:* (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.
